title: Lever launch, catch and reload
summary: A ball starts in the right arm's cup. The right arm must load it into the small basket of a passive see-saw launcher and move its cup away. The left arm, holding a mallet, must strike the lever so that the ball is flung up into free flight, and the right arm must catch it in its cup. The right arm then loads the ball into the basket a second time and clears away, and the left arm launches it again. In the end the ball must come to rest inside an open box that slides back and forth on a rail, while the box is moving. The left arm's mallet must never touch the ball.
robot_setup: Two Pandas facing each other along x. panda-0 (left): base at (-0.44, -0.23, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). Its tool is a mallet: a solid block 50 x 50 x 30 mm (along tool x, y, z), with the tool frame at its centre and axes parallel to the hand's when the hand points straight down (x forward, z up). The mallet is carried on an L-shaped side adapter of 12 mm square bars that runs forward from beside the hand, then sideways, then down onto the mallet's top near its -y edge. The mallet centre is 0.12 m ahead of the gripper TCP along tool x, 0.13 m to its tool +y side and 0.075 m below it. Start: mallet centre at (0.16, -0.11, 0.28), tool axes aligned with the world. panda-1 (right): base at (0.74, 0.23, 0), yaw pi (facing -x). Its tool is an open-top square cup: inside 0.14 x 0.14 m (2 x `tool_half`, 0.07 at this instance), walls 55 mm high and 5 mm thick on all four sides, 5 mm floor. The tool frame is the centre of the inside floor surface, z up, x pointing away from the arm's own base. With the cup level the hand points straight down and the cup's floor centre is 0.12 m ahead of the TCP along tool x and 0.04 m below it. The grey adapter enters at the middle of the cup's back (tool -x) wall: a 12 mm wide post protrudes 6 mm into the cup from the floor up to 35 mm, and a bar protrudes 12 mm into the cup between 29 and 41 mm above the floor. Start: cup floor centre at (0.12, 0.17, 0.26), level, rotated 180 deg about z (tool x = world -x). Wrist joints 5-7 of both arms use higher damping gains (24, 20, 14 instead of the default 12, 10, 7). Role labels per phase (left, right): physical_loading: cleared_striker, loader; first_launch: striker, preparing_catcher; right_catch: cleared_striker, catcher; reload_and_clear: cleared_striker, reloader; second_launch: striker, cleared_loader; moving_receptacle_retention: cleared_striker, cleared_loader.
scene: A small orange ball (radius 18 mm) starts at rest on the floor of the right arm's cup. A passive see-saw launcher stands in the middle of the table on an orange square post (the same orange as the ball). The launcher is blue: a lever on a horizontal hinge parallel to world y. At the lever's end on the left arm's side (-x) sits a small square basket (54 mm inside, 12 mm walls). On the other side of the hinge a side arm reaches toward -y to a strike pad (36 x 50 mm), which is held a few centimetres above the lever on a spring and can be pushed down by up to 30 mm. Pushing or striking the pad side down rotates the lever and swings the basket end upward along an arc around the hinge; stops limit the lever's travel. At rest the lever lies horizontal on its lower stop, because the basket side is heavier and a weak return spring also pulls it back to that position. Beyond the launcher, on the right arm's side, a blue open box (0.15 x 0.15 m inside, 0.06 m deep) rides a straight rail along y. The box is driven back and forth along the rail in a smooth sinusoidal oscillation by itself for the whole episode: slowly, and slowest where it turns around. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Ball: radius `radius` = 0.018 m, mass `object_mass` = 0.035 kg, restitution 0.1, friction 0.2. At reset it is placed at rest at the right tool frame's actual position + (0, 0, `radius` + 0.0005), i.e. on the centre of the cup floor (about (0.12, 0.17, 0.2785)). Launcher: a static pedestal 52 x 52 x 80 mm centred at (0.12, 0, 0.04), and on top of it the fixed lever base block (40 x 40 x 30 mm, centred (0.12, 0, 0.095)). Lever hinge at (0.12, 0, 0.13), axis world +y, limits q in [0, 1.2] rad; positive q lowers the +x (pad) side and raises the -x (basket) side. Reset at q = 0 with zero velocity. Lever link 'lever' (mass 0.07 kg), in its frame (origin on the hinge, x along the beam): beam 0.18 x 0.05 x 0.016 m spanning x in [-0.12, 0.06]; basket (54 x 54 mm inside, 12 mm walls) centred at (-0.12, 0) with its floor top at local z = 0.012, i.e. at world (0, 0, 0.142) when q = 0 (this is the announced `goal_target`); a 36 mm wide side arm at x = 0.04 running to y = -0.075 (`pad_offset` = -0.075). Pad link 'lever_pad' (36 x 50 x 12 mm, 8 g) sits on a prismatic joint along lever-local z at lever-local (0.04, -0.075, 0.045) (world about (0.16, -0.075, 0.175) at q = 0), with travel [-0.030, +0.002] m and a spring drive toward 0 (stiffness 80 N/m, damping 0.2, force limit 3 N). Lever return spring: hinge drive toward q = 0 with stiffness 0.008, damping 0.002 and effort limit 0.12; there is no other drive. Box ('cart'): prismatic fixture, rail centre (0.28, -0.03, 0.025), axis +y, limits +-0.5 m; inside 0.15 x 0.15 m, 0.06 m deep, inner floor at the link origin (z = 0.025 at the rail centre), moving mass 0.3 kg. A PD drive (kp 80, kd 8, force limit 8 N) tracks q*(t) = offset + 0.20 sin(w (t + shift)) with velocity target `fixture_speed` cos(w (t + shift)), where w = `fixture_speed` / 0.20 = 0.2 rad/s (period about 31.4 s). At reset: offset ~ U(-`fixture_offset`, +`fixture_offset`) = U(-0.025, 0.025) m is the first draw. Only if `fixture_phase` > 0 is a phase phi ~ U(-`fixture_phase`, +`fixture_phase`) drawn second, with shift = phi / w; at nominal `fixture_phase` = 0, so there is no draw and phi = shift = 0. The box starts at q = offset + 0.20 sin(phi) with dq/dt = `fixture_speed` cos(phi): at nominal q = offset, moving +y at `fixture_speed` = 0.04 m/s. This is an oscillation of 0.20 m amplitude about the offset with peak speed `fixture_speed`. Its target speed exceeds 0.02 m/s only while |cos(w (t + shift))| > 0.5: at this instance t < 5.2 s and 10.5 s < t < 20.9 s (the next window starts at 26.2 s, after the horizon). Box world y = -0.03 + q. No other random values; nothing is drawn after reset. Tools: `tool_mass` = 0.2 kg each, friction `tool_friction` = 0.3, restitution 0.05. Table friction `table_friction` = 0.08. `incoming_speed`, `preview` and `restitution` are not used by this task. Horizon `horizon` = 25 s.

phases.name: physical_loading
phases.text: the ball rests in the launcher's basket for 0.1 s without interruption. During that time the ball touches the lever (the lever link, basket included) and does not touch the right cup, and the lever is near horizontal (|q| < 0.12 rad). In the lever's frame (origin on the hinge axis, x along the beam toward the pad side, z normal to the beam), the ball centre is within 0.021 m horizontally of the basket centre (x, y) = (-0.12, 0) and between 0.024 m and 0.044 m above the hinge plane (the basket floor is at 0.012 m, so a resting ball sits at 0.030 m). The ball also moves at less than 0.08 m/s relative to the lever's centre-of-mass velocity. This is recorded once. After that, the right cup's tool frame must be more than 0.16 m away from the clearance point (0, 0, 0.18) (the ball need not still be in the basket at that moment).

phases.name: first_launch
phases.text: the left mallet (any part of panda-0's tool link) touches the lever or its pad; the first such contact in this phase is recorded. After that, the ball has touched nothing for more than 0.04 s while its centre is higher than z = 0.20 m.

phases.name: right_catch
phases.text: the ball drops into the right cup from free flight and stays there. Measured in the cup's tool frame, its centre crosses downward through the plane 0.073 m above the cup floor (wall height 0.055 m + radius), within 0.052 m (half width - radius) of the cup centre along both x and y, after the ball has touched nothing for at least 0.025 s. After that crossing the ball must stay retained in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. Retained means: its centre is at least 0.45 x radius inside the inner walls (|x|, |y| < 0.0619 m in the tool frame) and between 0.014 m and 0.0528 m above the cup floor; it has touched the cup within the last 25 ms; and it moves at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the cup (the cup's rigid-body velocity at the ball's position).

phases.name: reload_and_clear
phases.text: the same as physical_loading, counted again only within this phase. The ball rests in the basket for 0.1 s without interruption: it touches the lever and not the right cup, |q| < 0.12 rad, its centre is within 0.021 m of the basket centre and 0.024-0.044 m above the hinge plane in the lever frame, and its speed relative to the lever is < 0.08 m/s. After that, the right cup's tool frame must be more than 0.16 m from (0, 0, 0.18).

phases.name: second_launch
phases.text: the same as first_launch, counted again only within this phase: the left mallet touches the lever or its pad, and after that the ball has touched nothing for more than 0.04 s while its centre is higher than z = 0.20 m.

phases.name: moving_receptacle_retention
phases.text: the ball is inside the moving box, and the box moves along its rail faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. Inside means: in the box's frame the ball centre is at least 0.45 x radius inside the inner walls (|x|, |y| < 0.0669 m from the box centre) and between 0.014 m and 0.0578 m above the box floor; the ball has touched the box within the last 25 ms; and it moves at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the box. This completes the task.

task_failures: direct_ball_hit: at any time, the ball touches the left arm's mallet tool (any part of its tool link, adapter included).
contact_rules: The right cup (whole tool link) may touch the ball, the lever and the strike pad. The left mallet (whole tool link) may touch the lever and the pad, and by this task's rule never the ball (direct_ball_hit). Neither tool may touch the lever's base block, the orange pedestal, the moving box or its rail and base, or the table. No other robot part, the fingers included, may touch anything. The two arms and their tools may never touch each other, and no arm may touch itself.
world_goals_fixed: Clearance point (0, 0, 0.18): in physical_loading and reload_and_clear the right cup's tool frame must finally be more than 0.16 m from it. Launch height: in first_launch and second_launch the ball centre must be above z = 0.20 m.
world_goals_seeded: `goal_target`, the centre of the basket floor with the lever at rest, is announced at reset in the state. It does not depend on the seed but gives away the launcher's location: privileged mode only. The box's seeded rail offset (and phase, when `fixture_phase` > 0) is not announced.
difficulty_note: Two complete physical load-and-launch cycles go through a passive lever. Each strike must put enough energy into the lever to throw the ball above 0.20 m, the right arm must catch the ball from free flight in its cup, and the second launch has to end with the ball settled in a box that oscillates on its rail. The box must still be moving faster than 0.02 m/s while the ball settles, and it slows down near its turnarounds.
standard_notes: At t = 0 only the box on the rail is moving, and it keeps oscillating along the rail for the whole episode, so where it is at the second launch depends on how long the earlier phases took. The ball is visible in the right cup from the start. The launcher's post has the same orange colour as the ball.
